en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the dining hall.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we talk about?
Drinking green tea after a meal
Hm, yeah, I like green tea.
But not if it's too hot...

I like my teas to be slightly lukewarm. 
You might as well remember that.

Hmmm...thinking about it 
magically, that's correct.

If you don't eat and sleep well, 
you'll never become a good mage.

I guess I'll eat and sleep a lot, 
just like my master taught me.

I use a warding enchantment that 
stops me from ever getting fat.

Don't say such a rude thing to an 
ordinary girl who can use magic!

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Himiko looks deep in thought...
